risk_note: RV2 (freeze expiry and daily alerts, BR-ID-36; no migration). New risk-scan queue (exclusive, worker only) in the platform catalog; platform/queue has no cron, so a job chain keyed by time slot (freeze-expiry per UTC minute, daily-alerts per +08:00 date) is seeded by the worker right after the queue runtime starts (entry.ts). frozen_until reached -> normal per user in its own transaction (FOR UPDATE re-check, keyset batches of 100) through the single-writer risk state service; appealing, banned and indefinite freezes untouched; indefinite freezes over 30 days and overdue processing appeals warned daily. The frozen platform queue contract test is made tolerant of the risk-scan entry by the separate test-change B1-03s (#428), merged first. Audit row deferred (audit_logs is admin-only; same ruling as B1-03i). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
